description: Land Aquisition - Ilukkumbuwa, Laggala Palleyama D/S Division, Matale District - Rambukoluwa, laggala Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations, along with orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), the core content is focused on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
